name: rivi-workspace
description: RIVI Workspace, an open-source workspace on Cloudflare Workers: Mail on Email Routing and Email Sending, Drive on R2, an AI Assistant over both on Workers AI, Calendar and Tasks linked with GitHub Issues (TanStack Start on Vite, D1, R2, KV, Better Auth)

scripts.fix: ultracite fix -A unicorn/catch-error-name -A typescript/consistent-type-definitions -A unicorn/prefer-dom-node-append -A unicorn/prefer-dom-node-dataset -A unicorn/prefer-query-selector -A unicorn/prefer-at -A unicorn/prefer-set-has -A unicorn/prefer-spread -A unicorn/prefer-bigint-literals -A unicorn/prefer-import-meta-properties
scripts.verify:static: pnpm run check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run contracts:check && pnpm run format:check
scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:static && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:check
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/build-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute workspace-db --local --file=./seed/seed.generated.sql
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state && pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm run db:seed
scripts.setup: pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm run db:seed
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run db:migrate:remote && pnpm run deploy:assets && wrangler deploy
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist .wrangler/deploy worker-configuration.d.ts tsconfig.node.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.cloudflare.tsbuildinfo seed/seed.generated.sql
